seoTitle: How to Upgrade Your Hostinger Plan and Balance
metaDescription: See how to upgrade a Hostinger hosting plan in 2026, including moving to VPS or cloud hosting, and how unused subscription balance carries over.
intro: As a website grows, a basic hosting plan can start to feel limiting, and upgrading on Hostinger doesn't have to mean losing money you've already paid. This guide walks through moving to a higher tier or to VPS or cloud hosting, and explains how Hostinger applies your remaining balance toward the new plan.

steps.heading: Decide which plan fits your needs
steps.body: Compare your current plan against premium, VPS, or cloud hosting options to figure out which upgrade gives you the resources you actually need.

steps.heading: Start the upgrade from your dashboard
steps.body: Initiate the plan change from your Hostinger account, selecting the new plan you want to move to.

steps.heading: Review how your paid balance is applied
steps.body: Check how Hostinger credits any unused portion of your current subscription toward the cost of the new plan.

steps.heading: Confirm and complete the upgrade
steps.body: Finalize the change and verify your site or services are running correctly on the new plan afterward.

faq.question: Will I lose money if I upgrade my Hostinger plan?
faq.answer: No, Hostinger typically applies your unused subscription balance toward the new plan rather than charging you from scratch.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from shared hosting to VPS?
faq.answer: Yes, the upgrade process covers moving from a basic plan to VPS or cloud hosting for more resources.

faq.question: Does upgrading cause downtime?
faq.answer: The process is designed to be smooth, though it's a good idea to verify your site is functioning normally right after the upgrade completes.

faq.question: Who should consider upgrading their Hostinger plan?
faq.answer: Anyone looking to scale their website or get better performance and resources without losing the money already paid on their current plan.
